name: Farjana Reading Progress Bar
author: farjanaplugin

sections.description:
A professional and lightweight plugin to enhance user experience on your blog. This plugin shows a real-time progress bar as the user scrolls and displays an estimated reading time.

New in v1.1.0: An interactive “Shukriya” reward card with glassmorphism design that detects the story’s mood!

Key Features

  • Real-time Scroll Progress: A smooth progress bar at the top or bottom of the screen.
  • Estimated Reading Time: Automatically calculates reading time based on word count.
  • Interactive Reward Card: A beautiful glassmorphism pop-up appears when the user finishes reading.
  • Smart Content Analysis: Automatically detects story mood (Sad/Happy) and shows a personalized message.
  • Glassmorphism Design: Modern, blurred background style for the reading time box.
  • Fully Customizable: Change colors, font size, icons, and position from the admin panel.
  • Highly Lightweight: Minimal impact on site loading speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the farjana-reading-progress-bar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the .zip file via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Farjana Reading Time to customize the appearance.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Interactive Glassmorphism Reward Card at the end of reading.
  • New: Mood-based smart messages (Happy/Sad/Default).
  • Added: Multi-language support (Bengali & English) for the reward card.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Sanitization issues in settings.
  • Improved: Secure output escaping.
